data.one_liner: Key-value storage library for Dart/Flutter that safely reads and writes local data.
data.what_it_does: safe_local_storage provides a simple API to persist primitive values on the device. It supports Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux without requiring code generation.
use_when: Need lightweight local caching of small values
Want a single API that works across mobile and desktop
Prefer a dependency-free solution for simple persistence
avoid_when: Handling large binary blobs or complex data structures
Need advanced database features like queries or migrations

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard key-value storage with broader community support

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides encrypted storage for sensitive data
